referenceFunction.generalComment: A single engine helicopter of the type ecureuil-as-350-b3 with a weight of 1200kg and a life time of 10000 flight hours is assumed. The average flight duration is assumed to be 20min and 3 LTO per hour is required. Specific cruise emission factors for a ecureuil-as-350-b3 helicopter is provided of the federal office of civil aviation (FOCCA); UUID: ce66d6c4-4970-3282-b806-f4f0e20ffe27
